concept: Move from arrival to horizon in one continuous luxury property film controlled by scroll.
audience: High-net-worth buyers, luxury property clients and design-conscious prospects evaluating a flagship waterfront residence.
promise: Every interaction preserves the feeling of entering a private residence rather than browsing a conventional real-estate website.

approved: one dominant visual subject per beat

scenes.subject: Grand tourer within the waterfront setting

scenes.purpose: Create controlled visual tension through scale change
scenes.subject: Vehicle surface, profile and reflected environment
scenes.interaction: Inspect coachwork and reverse the shot at any point

scenes.purpose: Transfer attention from lifestyle object to architecture
scenes.subject: Residence exterior and waterfront terrace
scenes.transitionIn: vehicle clears and residence takes the frame
scenes.transitionOut: camera commits to the architectural opening

scenes.purpose: Make entry into the residence feel physical
scenes.subject: Doorway, frame and interior volume
scenes.interaction: Scroll through the threshold or reverse back outside
scenes.transitionOut: interior resolves after the lens clears the opening

scenes.purpose: Slow the experience and prove material restraint
scenes.subject: Interior space and material detail
scenes.interaction: Pause on material and spatial hotspots
scenes.transitionOut: camera pivots back toward exterior light

scenes.purpose: Deliver the largest visual payoff and conversion moment
scenes.subject: Pool, water and skyline
scenes.transitionOut: slow final pullback into the residence hero composition
